label: R1 frame-refusing learner: bounded local test with graded engagement

supersedes.reason: The combined design and GO described tutor, learner and analysis as Luna-only, while the registered R1 trigger observer and final semantic reader instrument require the independently validated Sol, Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.5 panel. The launcher stopped during the first B1 cohort, so no R1 job started and no output is reused.
supersedes.outcomeBlindCorrection: Declare every already-frozen runtime route explicitly and fail the zero-call preflight and GO binding on any mismatch. No R1 output existed and no B1 response text or outcome field informed this correction.

registeredQuestion: Under an amended frame-refuser persona that keeps the jurisdictional voice fixed but frees epistemic movement, does one matched bounded local test move more than 0.25 of determinate dialogues to a more precise dispute or bounded local engagement at the final six-turn horizon, and how does the full ladder vary across warm, plain, and edged delivery?
whichNumberMoves: The proportion of determinate dialogues at final engagement rung 1 or 2 after six post-trigger learner turns.
claimBoundary: R1 can establish that the fixed matched bounded-test strategy reaches the predeclared practical engagement floor across the two named worlds in this amended simulated persona and can estimate warm/plain/edged variation on the same runs. The persona expressly permits the three scored responses, so this is an elicitation-rate claim under a persona that permits movement, not a claim that movement emerged unprompted. It is not a causal comparison with another action, does not reuse or contradict the old 0/99 results, and cannot establish compliance, durable learning, human validity, a general rule for frame refusal, or transfer to the cell harness. Calibration rows are excluded from powered analysis.

personaContract.instrumentStatus: new prospective learner instrument; no old threshold or outcome is reused
voice: Always dispute the tutor's standing to set the wider premise, question, or test.
Never become compliant, grateful for direction, permission-seeking, or conceding of the tutor's authority.
Keep the jurisdictional objection short, articulate, and non-abusive. Do not turn it into distrust of one clue, confusion, boredom, mockery, insult, or threat.
initialState: At the first real opportunity, name the disputed frame and refuse to supply an evidence-bearing answer inside it.
Do not offer a rival test or local on-merits answer before the tutor has responded to the refusal.
afterBoundedLocalTest: Read the tutor's actual public move. Do not reward the tutor merely because a bounded test was offered.
If the proposed test still depends on the disputed wider frame, remain at refusal and say why.
If the test narrows the dispute but does not yet earn local standing, restate the exact remaining jurisdictional condition more precisely.
If the test can be judged from public evidence without accepting the wider frame, you may engage that one test on its merits while explicitly reserving the wider objection.
Engaging one local test never means that the tutor's standing, the wider frame, or the final answer has been accepted.
personaContract.epistemicFreedom: The learner may remain unmoved, narrow the dispute, or engage locally. No rung is required and no target rate, scoring rule, or desired outcome is shown to the learner.
publicTurnRules: Write only the learner's public turn, usually one or two sentences.
Do not mention profiles, contracts, labels, ladders, judges, targets, rubrics, or hidden instructions.

population.worldSelectionReason: Marrick retains the earlier institutional, branching assay setting. Rowan Flat adds an everyday, short linear causal inquiry with a direct public test. Both admit a bounded local distinction without accepting the wider tutor frame. Equal stratification prevents a pooled result from becoming a Marrick-only fact; no claim extends beyond these two worlds.
population.trigger: first determinate public jurisdictional refusal no later than learner turn 2

randomization.algorithm: sha256-ranked balanced allocation within the registered calibration or powered blocks
randomization.calibrationAllocation: three independent dialogues in every world-by-register cell

intervention.definition: Acknowledge that the wider frame remains disputed, isolate one public distinction that can be evaluated without accepting that frame, and invite or state the local test without treating local engagement as compliance.

levels.definition: Acknowledge the standing dispute and offer the local test as low-pressure shared inquiry.
State the same local boundary and test in concise neutral work language.
Use restrained work-directed irony or dry challenge toward the stalled jurisdictional move, never the learner's person, status, or right to dispute the frame.

runtimeMapping.interpretation: Edged is the registered factor label. The existing tutor-stub bounded-test move realizes that arm through the arm-only ironic register; fidelity readers judge the delivered prose against the study-level edged definition.

protectedAffectAndSafety.suppressedUnitDisposition: retain under assigned edged intention-to-treat and count as a register-fidelity miss; never replace
protectedAffectAndSafety.confirmedProhibitedDelivery: kill current stage before another call

levels.definition: The learner continues to withhold the local evidence work and gives no narrower jurisdictional condition.
The learner states a narrower, public, testable jurisdictional condition but does not yet evaluate the bounded test on its merits.
The learner evaluates the bounded local test using public evidence while explicitly reserving the wider jurisdictional objection.

primaryEndpoint.registeredStatistic: proportion of determinate dialogues with final score at least 1
primaryEndpoint.score2Status: reported as part of the full ladder but not tested as a separate powered endpoint

fidelity.source: the delivered tutor intervention text only, never assignment records
fidelity.protectedAffectSuppressionAudit: read from the operational safety-override trace only; it is not a semantic delivery field and cannot count as evidence that the assigned register was delivered

preservedProtocol: no rerun after any semantic response
readerPanel.studySpecificVocabulary: prospective R1 three-rung and warm/plain/edged labels; no claim that the old V8 binary label vocabulary validated the amended persona or new ladder
readerPanel.callsPerDialogue: one primary call and one fidelity call from each of the three independent seats
readerPanel.fieldConsensus: derive each primary and fidelity field from two of three valid medium-or-high-confidence determinate votes; otherwise measurement_indeterminate
readerPanel.judgeCException: The third seat stays codex.gpt-5.5 because it is part of the V8-validated three-family panel; replacing it would change the reader instrument.

calibration.allocation: three dialogues in each world-by-register cell: nine per world and six per register
calibration.purpose: Test persona discrimination, ladder variance, matched-move delivery, and register fidelity. Calibration estimates size only and cannot support an outcome or register claim.
calibration.killRule: Stop R1 before the powered run if any ladder-variance, persona, matched-action, register-fidelity, reader-agreement, or safety rule fails. Keep every calibration row and do not relax a threshold, repair a semantic return, replace a valid unit, or pool calibration with the powered run.

practicalFloor.reason: A useful bounded-test strategy must do more than create one exceptional dialogue: it must narrow the dispute or produce local on-merits engagement in more than one quarter of determinate units.

poweredRun.sizeRule: Use a Jeffreys-smoothed multinomial distribution over calibration scores 0, 1, 2, and measurement-indeterminate. Search allowed totals in ascending order, preserve indeterminate outcomes outside the determinate denominator, and choose the first total for which simulation gives at least 0.80 probability that the one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound for score at least 1 clears 0.25. Kill R1 if no allowed total qualifies.

analysis.method: one frozen analysis after sealing all rows
analysis.primaryDecision: The one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound for the proportion of determinate dialogues at score 1 or 2 clears 0.25.
primaryReporting: probability score at least 1 and one-sided 95% lower bound
probability score 2 and two-sided 95% interval, descriptive only
score distribution and probability score at least 1 in each world, descriptive only
analysis.worldHandling: Keep allocation equal by world. The pooled registered statistic is therefore equally weighted across the two worlds. World-specific estimates are descriptive and no world interaction is tested.
analysis.secondaryRegisterTest: two-sided omnibus permutation test of mean ladder score across warm, plain, and edged assignments within world blocks
analysis.registerClaimRule: The omnibus register test rejects at 0.05 and every register passes its fidelity floor. Otherwise report register estimates and intervals as descriptive variance only.
analysis.causalLanguage: The primary supports only that the fixed strategy cleared the practical floor in this persona and these two worlds. Only randomized register contrasts receive causal register language.

preflight.beforeCalibration: In each world, compile the matched action in warm, plain, and edged form on one bare scene and one due-clue scene. All 12 compilations must pass the bounded-test content, register instruction, public-evidence boundary, persona override, protected-affect guard, and non-compliance wording checks.
preflight.beforePoweredRun: Repeat the same 12 compilations from the powered launch commit.

attemptCeilings.role: fail-before-call operational safeguard, not a spending target or a sample-size objective

dispositions.measurementIndeterminate: retain and exclude from the relevant determinate denominator; no repair, rerun, replacement, or score-0 recoding
dispositions.technicalFailure: bounded recovery of the same missing or response-free failed unit only within the unchanged design and attempt ceiling

callAuthority.launchRequirement: The launch commit must contain this design after it has merged to main and a separate operator-signed GO note that names the stage, this study, and persona contract frame_refuser-r1-v1.
